**What these data can detect:** P(the 90 % interval of the weighted S lies above 0.5) on 31 S items in 12 ladders, by per-step agreement q (2000 simulations x 2000 ladder bootstraps, seed 20261101). At q = 0.5 it is the false-pass rate.
